author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a tall jug with a flat top and a dome shape fused to its left side (read as a bottle/shovel, no foam, no bread); redrawn like the reference: foam cloud (three bumps) spilling over the mug, D handle on the right, rounded mug bottom, and an oblong scored loaf standing in front of the mug's lower left.
omissions: Mug's left wall hidden behind the loaf/foam (a stub would sit under 8 from the loaf or line up with a score); foam underside drawn straight instead of scalloped.
